name: Panorama Small
description: Harvia Panorama Small offers a classic sauna atmosphere shaped by natural spruce and thoughtful design details.
The L-shaped bench layout provides flexible seating and the option to recline comfortably. Slim linden bench boards create a light visual appearance while remaining comfortable even in high heat.
Large clear tempered safety glass elements open the front visually, bringing brightness into the space. The interplay between vertical wall panels and horizontal bench lines adds depth and character.
Heater options include traditional electric, combi and pillar models. With Fenix touch control and optional MyHarvia connectivity, daily operation remains simple and reliable.
Panorama Small is delivered as a precision-made element cabin. Handedness can be defined during installation to suit your space.
Panorama Small is a practical, warm and inviting sauna for modern homes.

name: Panorama Large
description: Harvia Panorama Large combines generous proportions with natural materials for comfortable shared sauna sessions. Vertical spruce paneling shapes the interior and creates a calm, welcoming atmosphere, while the element structure supports steady sauna performance.
The L-shaped bench design allows both upright seating and comfortable reclining. Slim linden bench boards feel pleasant against the skin and maintain a light, elegant appearance.

The clear tempered safety glass front enhances openness and creates a brighter atmosphere. Subtle variations in panel thickness and orientation add character without overwhelming the traditional look.

Heating options include traditional electric, combi and pillar heaters, allowing you to tailor the steam intensity to your preference. Fenix control ensures intuitive daily use, with optional MyHarvia app connectivity for remote planning.
Panorama Large is delivered as an element cabin designed for efficient assembly. During installation, the handedness of the benches, heater and glass wall can be chosen according to the space.
Panorama Large offers generous space, natural materials and reliable Finnish heat.

name: Himalaya Small Infra+
description: The Harvia Himalaya Infra+ sauna cabin has the perfect balance of relaxation and therapeutic benefits. Designed for comfort, efficiency, and ultimate wellness, this sauna is ideal for up to 5 people and offers a range of features that make it the perfect addition to your home or wellness center.

With its ESG glass door and clear glass elements, this sauna is designed for both function and style. It comes with easy-to-follow assembly instructions and all the necessary materials. The Harvia Himalaya Infra+ sauna is also available as a custom build for personalized solutions.

Relax, rejuvenate, and enjoy the numerous health benefits of a Salt Sauna – from improving circulation to reducing inflammation and promoting skin healing. The Harvia Himalaya Infra+ Sauna is your path to a healthier, more balanced lifestyle.
highlights: Cabin made of solid spruce for durability and a natural look
Effective Infrared Heating: Includes a 350W full-spectrum infrared heater (with wooden backrest) to provide a soothing, deep-penetrating heat that enhances relaxation and promotes healing.

Salt Therapy Benefits: The sauna’s combination of salt bricks and gentle heat activates the hygroscopic properties of salt, releasing valuable minerals into the air, enhancing your breathing, skin health, and overall well-being.
Innovative Lighting: Enhance your sauna experience with the built-in RGBW color-changing lights, easily controlled via a 4-zone remote for a fully customizable ambiance.
Luxurious Interior: The interior features Lindenwood benches (620 mm), headrests, backrests, ventilation sliders, and a bank sight cover, all designed for maximum comfort during your sauna sessions.
